subject: Stage ownership countdown — Q2 coverage reconciliation and commit confirmation
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage ownership countdown — Q2 coverage reconciliation and commit confirmation

Team,

Finance pushed the Q2 forecast update this morning and we need a quick reconciliation for pipe-to-quota coverage. FP&A is working to lock the numbers by EOD Tuesday (4/13). Ask below — please treat as high-priority: 

1) For every open deal you own where stage = Proposal or Commit, confirm: ARR, realistic close month, and confidence (Low/Med/High).
2) If you plan to move a deal into commit (or out of commit), update HubSpot AND reply with the reason.
3) If there are any stage blockers (PO, security review, legal redlines), note the owner and ETA.

Coverage target reminder: leadership wants at least 2.2x weighted coverage for Q2 net new ARR. Current FP&A snapshot shows 1.6x — we need concrete delta and remediation actions.

Please reply inline for your deals. I attached a blank stage matrix to make this faster.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage ownership countdown — Q2 coverage reconciliation and commit confirmation

Aisha —

Quick update from my side (pulled latest HubSpot):
- BrightIT (RWI-4521) — Stage: Proposal -> realistic close: 2027-05, ARR: $180,000, Confidence: Medium. Current blocker: security questionnaire (waiting on SOC 2 evidence). Owner: Dylan. ETA: 2 wks.
- Apex Retail — Stage: Commit -> realistic close: 2027-04 (on track), ARR: $95,000, Confidence: High. No blockers.
- Greenline Health — Stage: Contract Review -> realistic close: 2027-06, ARR: $260,000, Confidence: Low (procurement timeline uncertain).

I moved BrightIT to Proposal in HubSpot last night to reflect the outstanding controls ask — will push updates to the secure folder and ping security.

On remediation: I can pull two low-probability deals out of coverage if leadership prefers a conservative stance, but that still leaves a ~1.8x coverage (not 2.2x). We should consider targeted play for 2–3 mid-market deals this week.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com

Adding my lineup and actions — pulled numbers from CRM and reconciled with my spreadsheet. Attached: Q2_stage_matrix_RWI-4521.xlsx and commit_changes_log.csv.

- Acme Corp (acme-sales@acme-corp.com) — Stage: Proposal. ARR: $420,000. Realistic close: 2027-05. Confidence: Medium. Blocker: Legal redline on data residency. Owner: Ben. ETA: 3 weeks. Action: Procurement kickoff scheduled 4/14.
- BrightIT (contact: Emma Turner <emma.turner@brightit.com>) — I own the commercial ask; joined call with Dylan last week. Recommend moving to Commit conditional on SOC2 evidence tick and signed SOW. Proposed commit amount: $170,000 (we'll align commercial math).
- Nimbus Media — Stage: Commit -> Actual close pulled in to 2027-04-28. ARR: $60,000. Confidence: High.

Note on coverage math: If BrightIT converts at proposed ~$170k and Nimbus closes, our weighted coverage rises to ~2.05x. Still shy of 2.2x. I flagged two late-stage mid-market deals (IDs listed in sheet) for rapid executive outreach.

Please update HubSpot immediately when you confirm changes. I will follow up with legal on the Acme redline and loop procurement.

Ben Carter

Thanks for the fast turn-around and the attachments. Recap and next steps (action owners + due dates):

1) Ben — Lead legal escalation on Acme redline. ETA: 2027-04-28. Update HubSpot with legal milestone.
2) Dylan — Work with Security to surface SOC2 evidence for BrightIT and share a clear gating checklist to Emma. ETA: 2027-04-25.
3) Ben/Dylan — Agree final commercial math for BrightIT and move to Commit in HubSpot if controls are satisfied. Hold me looped for any executive signatures.
4) Grace — Please run a 1-hr scrub with Marcus and FP&A tomorrow to test the sensitivity table in the attached matrix and confirm which deals we can reasonably accelerate. ETA: 2027-04-13 11:00AM PT.

FP&A asked for a consolidated CSV by EOD Tuesday (4/13). Ben, Dylan — I need your cleaned commit_changes_log.csv and the updated stage matrix by 11:00 AM PT on 4/13 so we can close the forecast. If we miss that window, finance will lock with conservative assumptions and we may lose flexibility on the commit used in coverage.

I'll compile and send the final reconciliation to Marcus and FP&A after your updates.

Thanks — appreciate the rapid responses.

Aisha
